response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional TypeScript, fullstack, and clean architecture expertise—meeting key technical requirements—he is significantly overqualified for this Junior/Mid-Level role. As a current Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of progressive career advancement, his seniority level creates substantial flight risk and likely salary misalignment. He also lacks specific PostgreSQL experience and renewable energy/construction technology domain background. A more junior candidate would be better aligned with role expectations.
strengths: Expert-level TypeScript and fullstack development with proven ability to architect and build scalable platforms across frontend, backend, and infrastructure layers
Strong software craftsmanship foundation with demonstrated emphasis on TDD, clean architecture, and testable code through professional work and open-source contributions
Exceptional technical breadth and learning agility across web, mobile, embedded systems, and emerging technologies including AI/ML infrastructure
concerns: Significant overqualification as Staff Engineer applying for Junior/Mid-Level individual contributor role signals high flight risk and misaligned career expectations
No explicit PostgreSQL experience listed; resume shows MySQL and MongoDB expertise instead, missing the role's stated preference
No renewable energy or construction technology domain experience; background spans finance, direct mail, GIS, and media industries
